analysis:
Integration pass over the selected-model recovery PR. Most of the diff is docs and tests. The production changes are small: ProviderLoop+AddonHold.swift (enterAddonHold now also cancels selectedModelRecovery.attempt?.task, tightening the T-059 load fence); ProviderLoop+Autopilot.swift:213 (noteSelectedModelUnloaded after a victim unload); ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift (makeAllDue after unload); ProviderLoop+Capacity.swift:82 (checkSelectedModelRecoveryIfDue on the capacity tick); ProviderLoop+ModelSwitch.swift:143 (the drain also waits on recovery.attempt == nil); ProviderLoop+Serve.swift and StartupShutdown (recovery task cancelled at shutdown, bounded 15s unloadAllModelsForShutdown); and additive optional DaemonState fields. The new recovery loader and placement policy are described as using allowEviction:false, a pause on drain or add-on hold, victim exclusions, dwell, idle and lease rules, and a per-victim recheck.

I found no concrete regression visible in the supplied lines. The changes touch no attestation, App Attest authorization (TB-011), key custody (A-003), coordinator wire format (TB-002), encryption or cache storage (T-041 posture unchanged). The new daemon-state and status fields carry only model IDs, timestamps and blocker strings, which are already public via heartbeats or are owner-local.

Unverified because source was not supplied (the integration replay was incomplete): ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift and ProviderLoop+SelectedModelPlacementPolicy.swift. Questions for them:
(1) The recovery load must go through ensureModelLoaded and addonHoldLoadRefusal (TB-012/T-059). The enqueue in StartupPreload checks no servingDrain.refusing. performPreRegistrationShutdown does not cancel the recovery task.
(2) Victim eviction happens before the load's own checks, and the hold must be rechecked at the plan instant.
(3) The adoption-release policy (marked pending owner review) is availability-relevant for A-018. It should honor holds and pins and let in-flight requests finish.
(4) Reload and evict churn: makeAllDue after every unload, including eviction-triggered ones.
(5) unloadAllModelsForShutdown must keep the old shutdown semantics. Abandoned slots keep residual GPU/KV data until process exit (T-028).
(6) The blocker string in the daemon state must not embed sensitive detail.
(7) A cancelled recovery attempt must clear its state so the model-switch drain cannot hang.
